missingValidation.action: Add isolated backend integration tests for real dynamic-import wrapping with recording enabled and disabled; verify trimmed/blank configuration, cached configuration reuse, cache reset, and injected-API bypass while recording is enabled.
Define and test directory creation, surface write, append, and projection failures. Assert whether recording failures may prevent API invocation or replace an API success/original error.

Test synchronous throws and exact error identity, original argument/receiver binding, return-value identity including undefined, constructor/value passthrough, and optional methods that are present but never called.

Add table-driven toRecordable tests for sorted keys, undefined/null handling, nonfinite numbers, buffers/views, dates, promises, streams, symbols/bigints, Map/Set, shared references/cycles, and Error.failureKind. Include invalid dates, throwing getters, and self-referential error metadata.

Use deferred promises to test out-of-order completion and exactly one outcome record per call. Test existing recording directories and multiple wrappers/processes, asserting the intended sequence and surface-overwrite policy or explicitly enforcing single-writer use.
Extend the offline packed-consumer smoke with recorder-enabled backend loading and recording-file assertions. Verify both source and compiled recorder files are packaged.
